tspan.tspan: Falling food prices have pulled India’s inflation down
Contribution to year‐on‐year CPI inflation, percentage points, January 2022 to
Source: MOSPI (CPI, base 2012, All‐India combined), Zerodha calculations
Contributions use MOSPI’s 2012‐base CPI weights and add up to headline inflation. Everything else
includes housing, fuel, clothing, transport, health and education.
Each bar is one month’s inflation, split into what each group of prices added to it. Parts
above zero pushed inflation up; parts below zero pulled it down.
